ch0367_00_gai/0101_0701_02_10:
If any people or Pokémon need a hand
today, let’s help ’em out!
ch0367_00_gai/7101_0701_01_10:
Y’know, we Team MZ members each have
our quirks, but we’re a reliable bunch.
ch0367_00_gai/7101_0701_02_10:
We all pitched in to protect the peace in
Lumiose.
ch0367_00_gai/7101_0701_03_10:
Team MZ can solve any problem, no matter
what we’re up against!
ch0367_00_gai/7102_0701_01_10:
If you ever get the chance to visit
Lumiose City, you should stay at Hotel Z!
ch0367_00_gai/7102_0701_02_10: I’ll make sure your room is spotless.
ch0367_00_gai/7102_0701_03_10:
Valued guest... Our humble establishment—
Hotel Z—awaits you!
ch0367_00_gai/7103_0701_01_10:
People recommend battling in teams of three
on this island, right?
ch0367_00_gai/7103_0701_02_10:
Hmm... Forming a team with Team MZ
members might be tough. I wouldn’t know
who to pick!
ch0367_00_gai/7104_0701_01_10:
You still haven’t tried my signature croissant
curry yet, have you?
ch0367_00_gai/7104_0701_02_10:
It’s my very own brainchild. I created it to
be Hotel Z’s sought-after signature dish!
ch0367_00_gai/7104_0701_03_10:
The exquisite pairing of croissants and curry
is irresistible!
ch0367_00_gai/7105_0701_01_10:
If a person or Pokémon needs help, you do
what you can immediately.
ch0367_00_gai/7105_0701_02_10:
You certainly have the makings of a Team
MZ member, [Name:PlayerNickname ]!
ch0367_00_gai/7105_0701_03_10:
If you wanna join, hit me up! I can introduce
you to everyone!
ch0367_00_gai/1701_0701_01_10:
Hey! Fancy meeting you here. I’ve got
something for you!
ch0367_00_gai/1701_0702_01_10:
Don’t worry about returning the favor! I just
wanna be helpful, is all!
ch0367_00_gai/2501_0701_01_10:
When we win a battle or succeed with a
strategy, you know what we gotta do.
ch0367_00_gai/2501_0701_02_10: A fist bump! Put them knuckles out!
ch0367_00_gai/2501_0701_03_10:
That’s how we celebrate each other’s
hard work!
ch0367_00_gai/2501_0702_01_10: I hope we get to have lots of fist bumps!
ch0367_00_gai/2501_0702_02_10:
So let’s do our best to keep helping people
and Pokémon!
ch0367_00_gai/2511_0701_01_10:
Back in Lumiose, I tried all sorts of stuff to
generate buzz around Hotel Z.
ch0367_00_gai/2511_0701_02_10:
Filming promo videos led me to lots of
encounters.
ch0367_00_gai/2511_0701_03_10:
Oh, right. I borrowed some funds for that,
didn’t I... Not a ton, though!
ch0367_00_gai/2511_0702_01_10:
There are some dangerous groups lurking
on this island, you know.
ch0367_00_gai/2511_0702_02_10:
They might try to entice you, but you gotta
be careful with people like that. Make sure
to protect yourself!
ch0367_00_gai/2511_0702_03_10:
And if anyone’s in trouble, we’ll help
’em out!
ch0367_00_gai/3001_0701_01_10:
Morning! Come join me for a bit!
I just had a great idea!
ch0367_00_gai/3003_0701_01_10:
Hey! I got us some croissants. Let’s have
a bite!
ch0367_00_gai/3005_0701_01_10:
When night falls, the Z-A Royale gets going!
...Well, in Lumiose, at least!
